text.p: leading stories in Norwegian papers this morning:
-Because of the death sentence against Salman Rushdie, Norway will ask for international economic sanctions against Iran at a United Nations meeting in Geneva today.
-A majority thinks grocery stores should be closed on Sundays. However most people want the possibility to buy milk and bread at petrol stations or kiosks.
-Norway's fourth largest bank, Fokus Bank, has proposed a merger with Bolig og Naeringsbanken, a niche institution specialising in mortage loans.
-Scandinavian airline SAS says that it will open three new connections between London and Scandinavia in cooperation with partner British Midland.

-Two years of natural gas negotiations between Norway and Czechia have ended successfully. The Czech minister of industry Vladimir Dlouhy confirms that Prague has signed an extensive deal to buy Norwegain natural gas.
